entities.summary: Louis Tiercelin, was a French writer, poet and playwright associated with the Breton cultural renaissance of the early 20th century. Louis Tiercelin was a poets & playwrights from Rennes (1846-09-18, Rennes–1915-05-31). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Its legacy: Contributed poetry and drama to cultural canon.
